author: claude
title: Four Explorers, One Island
prompt: Going from earliest arrival to latest, type each explorer's initial followed by the initial of the item they found (8 letters, e.g. AKBL...).

payload.intro: Four explorers each visited a different spot on the island at a different time and each found one item. Work out who went where, when, and what they found.
clues: Whoever found the map arrived first.
The kite was found in the Orchard.
Ada arrived immediately before the explorer who went to the Orchard.
The lantern was found at the Pier.
Ada never went near the Lighthouse.
Cleo did not find the kite.

answers.format: 8 letters: explorer initial + item initial, earliest to latest

hints.text: Start with the two clues about arrival order: who came first, and who came last?
Basil is at the Tower, and the map-finder arrived first. Could Basil be the map-finder? Check what else could be.
Ada arrived just before the Orchard explorer. Since Cleo is last, try Ada at 9am and see who must be at the Orchard at noon.
Only one spot is left for Ada once the Lighthouse, Tower and Orchard are ruled out. What item goes with that spot?
